description_en: Stops a specified run by using the ExecutorJobId returned by RunSemanticJob or ListSemanticJobRuns. A successful call indicates only that the stop request has been accepted. Query the final status by calling GetSemanticJobDetail
description_zh: 使用 RunSemanticJob 或 ListSemanticJobRuns 返回的 ExecutorJobId 停止指定运行。调用成功仅表示停止请求已受理，最终状态请通过 GetSemanticJobDetail 查询
name: KillSemanticJob

parameters.help_en: The executor job ID of the run to stop. Use the Data.ExecutorJobId value from the RunSemanticJob response or the ExecutorJobId value from a ListSemanticJobRuns record
parameters.help_zh: 待停止运行的执行器任务标识，使用 RunSemanticJob 响应的 Data.ExecutorJobId 或 ListSemanticJobRuns 记录中的 ExecutorJobId
parameters.name: executor_job_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the DataWorks workspace to which the job belongs. Use the ProjectId value from the CreateSemanticJob response or a ListSemanticJobs list item
parameters.help_zh: 待停止任务所属的 DataWorks 工作空间 ID，使用 CreateSemanticJob 响应或 ListSemanticJobs 列表项的 ProjectId
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The number of retries when sending the stop request to the executor. This parameter is typically optional. If specified, use a non-negative integer. After the call, confirm the final status by calling GetSemanticJobDetail
parameters.help_zh: 向执行器发起停止请求时使用的重试次数。通常可省略；传入时使用非负整数，并在调用后通过 GetSemanticJobDetail 确认最终状态
parameters.name: retry_times

schema.description_en: The standard response for the stop run request. The Data field indicates only the request processing result, not that the job has reached a desired state
schema.description_zh: 停止运行请求的标准响应。Data 只表示请求处理结果，不表示任务已经进入终态

Data.description_en: Indicates whether the stop request has been accepted by the executor. Even if true is returned, call GetSemanticJobDetail to query the final status
Data.description_zh: 停止请求是否已被执行器受理；返回 true 后仍应使用 GetSemanticJobDetail 查询最终状态

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. Used for locating logs and troubleshooting issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID。用于定位日志和排查问题

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
